Package com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim

Class LimelightCoordinates

java.lang.Object
com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim.LimelightCoordinates
public final class LimelightCoordinates extends Object
Conversions between the WPILib/PhotonVision conventions and the ones a real Limelight publishes to NetworkTables.

This class exists so the signs and axis orderings live in one place, with tests, instead of scattered through the translator. It is the easiest thing in the whole feature to get wrong.

Conventions used

  • Field space (botpose*): identical to WPILib. X+ along the field, Y+ to the left, Z+ up, angles in degrees. botpose_wpiblue uses the blue origin (the same one AprilTagFieldLayout uses by default), botpose_wpired the red origin, and plain botpose the legacy origin at the centre of the field.
  • Camera / target space (targetpose_cameraspace and family): X+ to the right, Y+ down, Z+ out of the camera or the tag. It is a right-handed system, related to WPILib's by a pure rotation.

    • pitchToTy

      public static double pitchToTy(double photonPitchDegrees)

      the equivalent ty value, in degrees.

    • botposeArray

      public static double[] botposeArray(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose3d pose, LimelightFrame frame, LimelightFrame.RawFiducial[] fiducials)
      Builds the complete botpose array LimelightHelpers expects: 6 pose values, 5 metadata values and 7 for each fiducial used.

      LimelightHelpers.getBotPoseEstimate only fills in rawFiducials if the length is exactly 11 + 7 * tagCount, so the number of fiducials passed here has to match the published tagCount.

      Parameters:
      pose - the robot pose, already in whichever origin the key calls for.
      frame - the frame the latency, span, distance and average area are taken from.
      fiducials - the fiducials to append; their length defines the published tagCount.
      Returns:
      the array ready for setDoubleArray.
